# jsonloupe

> A loupe for JSON that is too big — and too precise — for your viewer. Lossless,
> local-first JSON viewer/editor: int64 IDs and exact decimals survive
> paste → view → edit → copy → CSV export byte-exact; five-million-element arrays
> open instantly; compressed payloads (raw Zstd, Base64-Zstd, PostgreSQL bytea hex)
> paste straight in. No backend, no account, no telemetry — documents never leave
> the browser tab. MIT licensed.

Key facts for agents: numbers are boxed whenever their canonical float form differs
from the source bytes, so exact digits are preserved end-to-end (the reason this
tool exists). Documents over ~200 MB are refused with a clear message. With no API
key configured the page makes zero network requests; the optional ask-in-English
feature sends field names and types only, never values.

The npm package also exposes `jsonloupe-mcp` for local AI agents. It keeps the
document outside model context, returns ten query details by default, profiles
multiple or auto-discovered fields in one scan, compares and aggregates
int64/decimals exactly, and streams complete filtered results atomically to CSV
or JSONL. One-off analysis tools accept a file path directly and return a
reusable document id. The MCP server makes no network calls.

## Docs

- [Feature spec](https://jsonloupe.dev/spec.html): complete description of parsing,
  tree/code/split views, semantic diff, query language, tables and CSV export
- [Security policy](https://github.com/priyanshuN/jsonloupe/blob/main/SECURITY.md):
  the full inventory of every network call in the codebase, and how to report
  vulnerabilities (security@jsonloupe.dev)
- [README](https://github.com/priyanshuN/jsonloupe#readme): overview, screenshots,
  and local usage

## Code

- [Source repository](https://github.com/priyanshuN/jsonloupe): MIT, 300+ tests
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsonloupe): `npx jsonloupe` runs the
  identical app fully offline from a zero-dependency local server

## Usage

- [Hosted app](https://jsonloupe.dev): opens on paste, nothing uploaded
- [Changelog](https://github.com/priyanshuN/jsonloupe/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  version history
